statement: With E(b,j) := C(b,j+1) - C(b,j) under integer zero extension (C(b,m) = 0 for m < 0 or m > b) and Cat_j := C(2j,j)/(j+1): for every natural j and every natural b, E(b,j) >= -Cat_j, with equality IF AND ONLY IF b is in {2j-1, 2j} intersected with N. For j >= 1 the attaining set is exactly the two consecutive naturals {2j-1, 2j}; for j = 0 it is the singleton {0} (E(b,0) = b-1, Cat_0 = 1).
scope: Arithmetic auxiliary; independent of any graph or G1 hypothesis; the UNIQUENESS refinement of E993-BINOMIAL-DIFFERENCE-CATALAN-FLOOR (whose floor half it re-derives); the equality VALUE at b = 2j overlaps E993-PAIR-STAR-CLOSURE's Catalan-slack identity for j >= 3 only and is re-derived here for every j >= 0; NOT a corollary of FLOOR + E993-R25-BINOMIAL-DIFFERENCE-CATALAN-CEILING (which leave 2j values of b unexcluded at each j >= 1 and say nothing about b = 2j-1). statement: Conventions: C(n,j) zero-extended; Cat_m := C(2m,m)/(m+1) with Cat_m := 0 for m < 0; E(n,k) = C(n,k+1) - C(n,k); Gamma_n(tau,k,n) = E(n,k) - sum_{a=1}^{tau} C(tau,a) Cat_{k-a}; with n = 2r+d-tau at the minimal admissible rank r = k+1 and slack s = d - tau, so n = 2k+2+s, the residue R(tau,s) := {k >= 1 : Gamma_n(tau,k,2k+2+s) <= 0} (NON-STRICT: Gamma_n = 0 is inconclusive and is in the residue; k >= 0 gives the same sets since Gamma_n(tau,0,2+s) = s+1 > 0; the graph order of a cell is 2r+d = n+tau). For tau = 1..7: R(1,s) empty for every s; R(2,0) = {1}; R(3,0) = {1,2}; R(4,0) = {1,2,3}; R(5,0) = {1,...,5} (orders 9, 11, 13, 15, 17), R(5,1) = {1,2} (orders 10, 12); R(6,0) = {1,...,11}, R(6,1) = {1,2,3}; R(7,0) = {1,...,69}, R(7,1) = {1,2,3,4}, R(7,2) = {2} (n = 8, order 15, Gamma_n = 0 exactly); empty at every larger slack. Equivalently R(tau,0) = {1,...,K(tau)-1} with K(1..7) = 0,2,3,4,6,12,70 (so K(1..7) are the LEAST positivity thresholds), R is nested decreasing in s, and R(tau,s) is non-empty iff s < s*(tau) with s*(1..7) = 0,1,1,1,2,2,3.
